claims.text: Fibromyalgia: pregabalin 300 to 450 mg/day. Start 75 mg two times a day (150 mg/day); may increase to 150 mg two times a day (300 mg/day) within 1 week by efficacy and tolerability.
claims.quote: The recommended dose of LYRICA for fibromyalgia is 300 to 450 mg/day. Begin dosing at 75 mg two times a day (150 mg/day). The dose may be increased to 150 mg two times a day (300 mg/day) within 1 week based on efficacy and tolerability.

claims.text: Doses above 450 mg/day are not recommended.
claims.quote: treatment with doses above 450 mg/day is not recommended

claims.text: Gabapentin: respiratory depression may occur with CNS depressants, including opioids, or with underlying respiratory impairment; monitor and adjust the dose as appropriate.
claims.quote: Respiratory Depression: May occur with NEURONTIN when used with concomitant central nervous system (CNS) depressants, including opioids, or in the setting of underlying respiratory impairment. Monitor patients and adjust dosage as appropriate

claims.text: Antiepileptic drugs, including gabapentin, increase the risk of suicidal thoughts or behavior.
claims.quote: Antiepileptic drugs (AEDs), including NEURONTIN, increase the risk of suicidal thoughts or behavior in patients taking these drugs for any indication.

claims.text: Monitor for new or worse depression, suicidal thoughts or behavior, or unusual changes in mood or behavior.
claims.quote: Patients treated with any AED for any indication should be monitored for the emergence or worsening of depression, suicidal thoughts or behavior, and/or any unusual changes in mood or behavior.
